baseline_note: Automated references describe repository checks, not their latest result. Installed and live entries preserve the date and limits of available observations; no current live verification is claimed.

prerequisites: Antigravity installed; user-profile MCP configuration access for a live setup check.
limitations: Tests use temporary configuration files; they do not modify or verify a user's installed IDE configuration.
Host discovery observation is dated 2026-10-05; current host version and reload behavior are unverified.

limitations: Automated runtime tests use temporary state, fake Docker and mocked or loopback HTTP; they do not start Docker or Strata.
The slow-drip loopback check observes partial-body delivery, probe timeout and disconnection; it is not real Strata telemetry.
No current installed runtime or live model readiness check is recorded.

prerequisites: Configured endpoint expected to be available; an actual probe contacts that endpoint.
limitations: The installed SDK smoke is dated 2026-10-04 and proves one fresh-client call, not this chat transport.
The Antigravity probe is user-reported and dated 2026-10-05; it is not a current endpoint check.
Availability/model listing is distinct from readiness inference.

prerequisites: Trusted repository, committed task spec, trusted named test profile, installed Aider, and available configured model endpoint.
limitations: Automated end-to-end runs use fixture repositories and fake Aider; they do not establish model quality or host behavior.
External test executables must be selected by a bare name resolved through PATH; an absolute external argv[0] is rejected. This does not change the separate aider_python setting.
Historical live tasks are single synchronous smokes; neither proves repeatability, async survival, nor current performance.

prerequisites: Trusted repository and profile; for Windows survival proof, a test host that permits required Job Object breakaway.
limitations: The public worker CLI handler has a monkeypatched unit check; that does not prove a user-launched worker command completes a real job.
The Windows disconnect/reconnect E2E is skipped inside restrictive Job Objects; CI and the available host did not provide an accepted Windows survival proof.
Polling and persistence do not prove host wakeup or agent-turn resumption.

prerequisites: Persisted run record, exact patch artifact, matching repository baseline, and a named test profile for acceptance.
limitations: Controller verification uses disposable Git fixtures and local test commands; it does not authenticate reviewer identity or integrate changes.
The review record CLI had service-level coverage only before this journey was added.

prerequisites: Installed package and a compatible host or MCP SDK client able to launch its stdio entry point.
limitations: The installed SDK client observation is dated 2026-10-04 and is not a clean-machine install rehearsal or host-session proof.
Codex, Claude Code, and Antigravity behavior depends on host configuration, approval, and reload state.

prerequisites: An explicit repository root and an operator-selected retention threshold.
limitations: Tests use temporary artifacts; they do not inspect or remove a user's retained run data.

prerequisites: Existing persisted trusted job; installed/authenticated Codex CLI supporting queue; exact target chat UUID and explicit host-model continuation approval.
limitations: The dated direct codex queue probe produced an automatic desktop response; it does not verify the integrated CLI from an installed package or repeated reliability.
Queue acceptance does not prove model completion or desktop visibility; the bridge does not collect model replies or token usage.
The selected chat retains its context, permissions and integrations; this CLI handoff is not an MCP Tasks notification or a whole-feature controller.
An uncertain delivery is not automatically retried; receipt removal defeats replay protection. Earlier App Server records describe a removed experimental transport.
Per-thread advisory locks coordinate bridge calls within one repository; concurrent queueing from different repositories remains unverified.

prerequisites: Built wheel and source distribution plus uv for the optional isolated installation smoke.
limitations: The distribution installation smoke is opt-in via HYBRID_SDLC_PACKAGING_DIST; a skipped test is not installed-package evidence.
The source tree is not a clean consumer machine.

gaps: No current clean-machine wheel/sdist installation and user-level host registration/reload rehearsal is recorded.

No current live endpoint, full host tool-use matrix, or Windows background survival proof is recorded; the dated direct codex queue wakeup observation is not an installed-package rehearsal of the integrated bridge.
Do not infer product regressions from absent harness coverage or infer passing live behavior from fixture tests.
